usedFor: Cakemail runs the campaigns and contact tags, and Google AI Studio (Gemini) writes text from a prompt through “Generate Content”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Campaign” in Cakemail, then “Generate Content” in Google AI Studio (Gemini)
bestTemplate.why: A new campaign is when copy is needed, and the action generates content from your prompt.

watchOut: “Generate Content” works from a prompt, so write clear instructions once and read the first results before relying on them.
